# pvecli ct snapshot

Manage container snapshots.

## add

Create a container snapshot.

```text
pvecli ct snapshot add [CTID] [NAME] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CTID` | Container ID (CTID). |
| `NAME` | Snapshot name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-de`, `--description VALUE` | Snapshot description. |
| `-w`, `--wait` | Wait for operation to complete. |

## remove

Delete a container snapshot.

```text
pvecli ct snapshot remove [CTID] [NAME] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CTID` | Container ID (CTID). |
| `NAME` | Snapshot name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |

## rollback

Rollback container to a snapshot.

```text
pvecli ct snapshot rollback [CTID] [NAME] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CTID` | Container ID (CTID). |
| `NAME` | Snapshot name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-w`, `--wait` | Wait for operation to complete. |
| `-rb`, `--reboot` | Reboot container after rollback. |

## list

List container snapshots.

```text
pvecli ct snapshot list [CTID] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CTID` | Container ID (CTID). |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
